asset_selection: Choose mature compatible assets first when they meet the game's art direction and quality. Compare original candidates on actual output, not tool novelty.

hunyuan_full.role: preferred local form candidate after the same-image shell comparison and user steering
hunyuan_full.minimum_output_stage: Blender refinement, UV/materials, fresh import and Unity Windows validation

hunyuan_mini.role: optional lightweight candidate; not selected for the shell prop
hunyuan_mini.quality_policy: keep evidence and switch tools when actual output is inferior

characters: Prefer licensed production topology and skeleton. Do not promote Mini meshes as rigged characters without separate topology, skinning, deformation and retargeting proof.

fab.download: authenticated Fab UI or Epic Games Launcher

promotion: separate project-specific visual and gameplay acceptance
